lede: Witness protection and case confidentiality training helps professionals who handle witnesses and sensitive case information reduce exposure risks. Participants practise assessing threats, planning protection measures, controlling access to identities and records, and communicating securely, while learning to document actions and respond to leaks or retaliation.
audienceIntro: This course is ideal for professionals who handle witnesses, sensitive identities, evidence, or confidential case data.
audience: Victim support officers and social workers
Court officials and case management personnel
modules: Foundations of Witness Protection and Confidential Case Handling
Threat Assessment and Risk Profiling for Witnesses
Witness Intake and Safe Initial Contact Protocols
Secure Documentation, Evidence Handling, and Chain-of-Custody
Witness Protection Planning and Support Measures
Court Preparation and Safe Testimony Management
Biases, Mistakes, and Common Confidentiality Failures
Incident Response for Leaks, Threats, and Retaliation
Ethics, Accountability, and Building a Confidentiality Culture
prerequisites: Participants should have basic experience in case management or investigative roles. Familiarity with handling sensitive information is recommended.
